name: Amazon Ancient Ruins
notes: V0.5.4 promotes eight upper-temple transforms from page 24: two Trans-Neon Orange 6126 flames, two Light Gray 6091 curved spout bodies, two Light Gray 4081b light-attachment plates, and two Blue 3039 roof slopes.
The two page-18 flame occurrences are disambiguated from the other five set flames by their shared high-elevation temple cluster in the LDD geometry.
The two page-19 6091/4081b pairs share matching x/z coordinates in the CAD cross-check, matching the manual's two identical gray top fixtures.
The two Blue 3039 roof slopes are the remaining two Blue 3039 inventory occurrences after the existing temple/gateway placements and occupy the crown immediately below the page-24 bat.

Two old Light Gray 6081 roof shapes were disproven by the CAD spatial index; they remain rendered temporarily but are explicitly excluded from the 420-part ledger until relocated to their correct assembly.
Page 22's Light Gray 30104 chain, page 24's bat and palm leaf, pages 7-8 car transforms, and pages 28/30 bridge-gateway transforms remain exact.
Instruction-exact slots store explicit instructionTransform data; playable scene coordinates remain separate presentation transforms.
CAD candidates remain non-authoritative until corroborated by captured instruction pages.
World-space convention: one unit equals one LEGO stud pitch.
